learningGoals: Recognize, spell, and write their own name confidently in English. ✍️
Understand that names are special and part of their unique identity. 🌟
Learn vocabulary related to alphabets, writing, and self-introduction. 🗣️
Identify the first letter of their name and find other words that start with the same letter. 🔤
Practice introducing themselves to others using simple English phrases. 🤝
conversationStarters: Do you know who picked your name when you were born? Let's talk about it! 👶
If you could have a secret nickname that only your best friends knew, what would it be? 🕵️‍♂️
What is your favorite letter in your name, and why do you like drawing it? 🖍️
teachingTips: Write your child's name in large letters and have them trace over it with different colored crayons (rainbow writing). 🌈
Talk about the meaning or history behind their name to make them feel proud of it. ❤️
Point out the letters of their name on signs, in books, or on cereal boxes during daily life. 🥣
Practice self-introduction: 'Hello, my name is [Name]. What is your name?' 🎤
Clap out the syllables of their name and the names of family members to teach rhythm in words. 👏

funActivities.title: Make a Name Plate 🚪
funActivities.description: Use thick paper and decorations (stickers, glitter, markers) to create a beautiful name plate for their bedroom door.

funActivities.title: Letter Hunt Game 🔍
funActivities.description: Write various letters on sticky notes and hide them around the room. Ask your child to find only the letters that make up their name and put them in order.

funActivities.title: Acrostic Name Poem 📜
funActivities.description: Write their name vertically. Help them come up with one positive English word that starts with each letter of their name (e.g., S - Smart, A - Awesome, M - Magical).
